Q: Tauri JSON5 - supported (but disabled) format encountered . json5 - try enabling 'config-json5' A:

first, cargo add json5

Then, find your Cargo.toml (should be at /myapp-app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml)

build-dependencies and dependencies will look something like this:

[build-dependencies]
tauri-build = { version = "2", features = [] }

[dependencies]
tauri = { version = "2", features = ["devtools"] }

make it look like this

[build-dependencies]
tauri-build = { version = "2", features = ["config-json5"] }

[dependencies]
tauri = { version = "2", features = ["devtools", "config-json5"] }

This should now build/compile.

Q: Snyk doesn't check vulnerabilities in main code files A:

Try scanning with SnykCLI try to scan container image it gives the best results.

We also have UI but it doesnt give best results snykCLI is the best
install docker desktop first

Install snykCLI

authenticate Snyk

then pull the docker image with docker pull "image name"

finally test the image with command snyk test "image name" it give the best result by scanning all the dependencies including js files and all

Q: How to search and replace unicode characters with a Word macro? A:

Here the version, for you request;

Sub Clean_Unicode_Full()
    Dim oDoc As Document
    Dim aReplacements As Variant
    Dim i As Integer
    
    Set oDoc = ActiveDocument
    
    aReplacements = Array( _
        Array(ChrW(&H2013), "-"), _
        Array(ChrW(&H2014), "-"), _
        Array(ChrW(&H2018), "'"), _
        Array(ChrW(&H2019), "'"), _
        Array(ChrW(&H201C), """"), _
        Array(ChrW(&H201D), """"), _
        Array(ChrW(&H00A0), " "), _
        Array(ChrW(&H2009), " "), _
        Array(ChrW(&H2026), "..."), _
        Array(ChrW(&H2022), "-") _
    )
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    
    For i = LBound(aReplacements) To UBound(aReplacements)
        With oDoc.Content.Find
            .ClearFormatting
            .Replacement.ClearFormatting
            .Text = aReplacements(i)(0)
            .Replacement.Text = aReplacements(i)(1)
            .Forward = True
            .Wrap = wdFindContinue
            .Format = False
            .MatchCase = False
            .MatchWholeWord = False
            .MatchWildcards = False
            .Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll
        End With
    Next i
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    MsgBox "Unicode replacement complete." & vbCrLf & _
           "Processed " & UBound(aReplacements) + 1 & " rules.", _
           vbInformation, "Clean Unicode"
           
    Set oDoc = Nothing
End Sub

Q: how to cache asyncio coroutines A:

One option is anyio.functools.cache. Note that this requires at least version 4.12.0.

To use:

from anyio.functools import cache

@cache
async def ...

Similar to async-lru, if there's another call to the function while one is pending, it will just wait for the previous call.

Comparing popularity, it's more popular than all of the existing options posted here: its GitHub has 2.1k stars at the time of writing, while aiocache has 1.4k stars and async-lru has 940 stars. The rest have less.
